thresholds.method_a_title_author_pgid: NOT COMPUTABLE — neither InfiniteBench records nor pg19_train.jsonl carry title/author/PG-ID metadata.

method_b_exact_hash.note: eval contexts are anonymized whole books; the training corpus is concatenated lines with no document boundary, so a book-level exact-hash match is structurally impossible and is reported as 0 by construction. Content overlap is measured by method (c).

method_c_ngram_containment.downsample_rule: keep hash h iff (h %% downsample) == 0 (bottom-hash / MinHash sketch)
method_c_ngram_containment.containment_definition: |unique eval n-gram sketch hashes present in train sketch| / |unique eval n-gram sketch hashes|
method_c_ngram_containment.verdict_rule: >= contam_high => CONTAMINATED; < contam_low => CLEAN; else PARTIAL
